assumptions.entry: next 5-minute bar open after a finished signal candle
assumptions.gapHandling: skip if the open has crossed the stop, reached T1, or widened stop beyond the rule's limit
assumptions.exit: stop checked before target when both lie inside one bar; flat by 15:15
assumptions.cost: 0.05% of underlying notional per side, deducted in R; excludes option spreads/IV/theta and is an assumption
assumptions.vix: previous completed session close compared with the preceding 60 closes; treated as a grouping variable, not a trade blocker
assumptions.confidenceInterval: 95% day-cluster bootstrap, 2,500 resamples; exploratory, not a preregistered holdout
assumptions.limitations: underlying index only; no historical option bid/ask or premium P&L; Yahoo history may be revised
